vendoring.rationale: Preserve the locked runtime implementation, licenses, native registrations and declared runtime assets. No private Flutter SDK imports, compatibility facade, added analyzer ignores or relaxed gates.

changes: Remove the unnecessary named library declaration.

Use MediaQuery.textScalerOf(context) for ambient nonlinear text scaling; preserve explicit textScaleFactor overrides with TextScaler.linear and the intentionally unscaled WidgetSpan child with TextScaler.noScaling.
Remove the unreachable default from the exhaustive HighlightBinding switch; document the existing catch fallback without changing its control flow.
Replace the public legacy Material import with package:material_ui/material_ui.dart; preserve widget logic and public signatures.
